To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1) Slow is a way to be and a way of doing that can be applied in learning design.

1) the slow approach to learning design is a philosophy of slow that accepts into itself all time scales of university life; 2) the key elements in the philosophy of slow include untangling, opening up, loosening, seeing, listening and trusting; and 3) the key benefits of a philosophy of slow include choice, re-orientation to the spaces that we are in and re-connection to the places that we are already.
The slow philosophy offers a different way of being in learning design that is more generative and more grounded in the here and now.

how we can re value the spaces that we already inhabit as places of possibility.
the ways in which we might re value the time and space we are already in, and how that might change our practice and our experience of learning design.
